references.text: Jephthah (Yiftach) was a Gileadite and a mighty warrior who became a judge in Israel. The name Jephthah in Judges is the same Hebrew name (יִפְתָּח) as the city mentioned in Joshua 15:43.
Jephthah judged Israel for six years. His name is identical to the city name Iptah mentioned in Joshua's land allocation.
The book of Hebrews mentions Jephthah among the heroes of faith. The Greek name Ἰεφθάε corresponds to the Hebrew יִפְתָּח, which is also the name of the city in Joshua 15:43.
